UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile metadata stored under users/{uid}.

displayName.description: Display name for the authenticated user.

email.description: Email address of the authenticated user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created.

Folder.title: Folder
Folder.description: User-owned folder for organizing file metadata.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the folder was created.

FileItem.title: FileItem
FileItem.description: Metadata-only file entry owned by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the file metadata was created.

Note.title: Note
Note.description: Personal workspace note owned by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

TeamMember.title: TeamMember
TeamMember.description: Team member directory entry owned by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the team member was added.

/users/{uid}.description: User profile document isolated per authenticated UID.

/users/{uid}/folders/{folderId}.description: Folders belonging exclusively to the authenticated user.

/users/{uid}/files/{fileId}.description: File metadata entries belonging exclusively to the authenticated user.

/users/{uid}/notes/{noteId}.description: Notes belonging exclusively to the authenticated user.

/users/{uid}/teamMembers/{memberId}.description: Team members belonging exclusively to the authenticated user.
